Cheaper alternative. Sits ON the 40-pin GPIO header (incl. riser to pass signals up to the ADC HAT). 2x 18650 cells (not incl). 2.5A output. I2C monitoring only - you script the shutdown (no auto-shutdown MCU).
Full-speed only (12 Mbps) - fine for serial/RS-232 instruments. Breaks leakage-current ground path to patient-connected gear (IEC 60601).
